The failing test is `testReadingOfFirstStoredEntry()` in class `ZipArchiveInputStreamTest`. It expects to read a stored ZIP entry from the ZIP stream, but the byte array contents do not match the expected values.

The test failure occurs at the assertion line where the code compares the actual byte array read from the `ZipArchiveInputStream` with the expected byte array {'d', 'a', 't', 'a', '\n'}. The first byte differs, showing actual 0 instead of the expected 100 (ASCII for 'd').

The relevant method to check is `org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipArchiveInputStream.getNextZipEntry()` since it is called to get the next entry in the archive. Also, the method `read(byte[], int, int)` and readStored(byte[],int,int)` might be involved in reading the contents of the entry, so these could be relevant for reading the data from the stored entry.

Next, I will check the code snippet of `org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipArchiveInputStream.getNextZipEntry()` to understand how the entry is retrieved and loaded.
